independent_units: Complete model architecture (width x depth); shared training corpus and validation set do not establish independent data-generating experiments.
limitations: Curator-only: acquisitions contain historical responses; never expose source-root to discovery workers
No test targets are exported and no evaluator vault is read or created
Reconstruction does not establish scientific admission, independent evidence or redistribution rights

partition_provenance.allocation: Original confirmation groups retained; development groups sorted by canonical SHA256([compact-v2, case, opaque group]); first max(2, floor(n/5)) become dev. Explicit source identities, not numeric folder matching.

policy.calibration: Last observed positive finite checkpoint at or before 10B and at or before 20B tokens; distinct and earlier than all forecast points
policy.excluded: Global/final summary losses, fitted parameters, cooldown trajectories, future checkpoints and extra source fields cannot become inputs
policy.forecast: All recorded positive finite loss checkpoints with 20B < tokens <= 100B; missing checkpoints explicitly recorded, no interpolation
policy.split: Frozen complete-architecture assignments, identical to historical compact-v2 partitions
policy.stage: pretrain true, cooldown false; one hot history per architecture

reference_parser_provenance.reuse: Measurement and identity specification reimplemented; no upstream fitting, scientific formula, reference state or evaluator copied

units_evidence.loss: Recorded val_loss; historical contract declares nats/token, not a new loss-function validation
